xai/grok-4.7.maxOutput: vendor: "No text output limit" (bounded by the 500K window); 450,000 recorded from OpenRouter max_completion_tokens (second source, the lower value)

reasoning.parameter: reasoning_effort (xAI SDK, Chat Completions) or reasoning.effort (Responses API)
reasoning.tokensBilled: reasoning tokens are billed at the completion (output) token price
reasoning.rejectedParameters: presencePenalty, frequencyPenalty and stop return an error on reasoning models

caching.mode: automatic prefix caching, from the start of the messages array
caching.affinityKey: prompt_cache_key (Responses API) or x-grok-conv-id header (Chat Completions); without it you often pay full input price on a cache-cold server
caching.ttl: none stated: entries can be evicted at any time due to server load or restarts
caching.writePremium: none stated (write recorded at the input price)
caching.breaks: any edit, removal or reorder of earlier messages; omitting reasoning content from previous responses (send encrypted reasoning back or use previous_response_id)
caching.longContext: cached tokens count toward the 200K threshold and use the long-context cached rate

longContext.tierEncoding: aboveInputTokens 199999, because the contract tier is strictly greater-than

xai/grok-4.7.residency: default endpoint https://api.x.ai does not guarantee a processing region; model pages list us-east-1, us-west-2, us-central-1
xai/grok-4.7.dataRetention: API requests and responses kept 30 days (encrypted) for abuse auditing, not trained on; team-wide self-serve ZDR where available (disables stateful Responses, Files, Collections, Batch, deferred completions)
xai/grok-4.7.anthropicMessagesEndpoint: deprecated ("The Anthropic SDK compatibility is fully deprecated")

tools.toolCallStreaming: a function call arrives whole in one chunk

xai/grok-4.7.violationFee: $0.05 per request caught before generation on the Responses API; violations caught after generation are still charged
